rows.label: Vox Solaris
rows.note: unlocks The Business, Smokefinger, Ticker and Solaris United standing

rows.label: free Companion slots
rows.note: one for Oxylus, one for its Multron

conditions: Free both slots before claiming it from the Foundry.
The daily cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, so this is a multi-day climb.
Before Old Mate the Kubrodon lure isn't for sale; tranq wild Kubrodons when they show up.
bonuses: Mining counts twice: raw gems turn in to Smokefinger for standing, and this build needs the Goblite and Axidite anyway.
Old Mate also unlocks Profit-Taker and amps, so most players do this climb eventually.

disclosures.title: fastest standing
disclosures.body: Near-unanimous: Conservation with the Tranq Rifle and the best Echo-Lure you can buy, on a sleep or stealth frame (Ivara's Sleep Arrow, or Equinox or Titania with Equinox's sleep subsumed) for perfect captures. Once Old Mate opens the Kubrodon lure and pheromones, a few Kubrodon captures hit the cap in 10-30 minutes. Deck 12 and the big caves have dense mining nodes with few enemies; Resourceful Retriever on a beast can double pickups.

conditions: Bonds are the real rank-up bottleneck; check Ticker every visit.
Stage 1 of a Vallis bounty pays no bonds, so run bounties to the end.
bonuses: Narmer bounties were named more than once as quick standing plus bonds.

rows.label: Oxylus Blueprint
rows.alt: claim it as the free Rank 5 vendor item

conditions: A Cetus spear damages servofish, and a damaged fish dismantles into fewer parts.
bonuses: Taking the blueprint as the Old Mate freebie saves 20,000 standing, about a day of cap.

groups.activity: mine blue gem and red ore veins

rows.label: Goblite
rows.note: 2 refines of 10 Goblite Tears, 2,500 cr each

rows.label: Axidite
rows.note: 3 refines of 20 Axidrol Alloy, 1,000 cr each

conditions: Hold back 20 Goblite before turning gems in to Smokefinger for standing.

groups.sub: Coolant Reservoir, outside the Fortuna elevator
groups.activity: spear Longwinders in hotspots, dismantle at The Business

rows.label: Scrap
rows.note: 2-4 per Longwinder by quality; common fish cover the rest

conditions: Warm lasts about 4 minutes of every ~26-minute cycle; if you're catching Sapcaddy it's Cold and no Longwinders spawn.
Fish only in hotspots, the oily green shimmer on the water.
Bait lifts the spawn chance for about 3 minutes; a second bait of the same type in the same hotspot does nothing.
A Resource Booster doubles the Longwinders you catch but not the Scrap from dismantling.
bonuses: Luminous Dye makes the fish easier to see.

rows.label: Oxylus
rows.note: 15 Goblite Tears, 45 Axidrol Alloy, 40 Scrap, 10 Longwinder Lathe Coagulant

conditions: Oxylus and its Multron are separate Mastery items; level both.

disclosures.title: what you're getting
disclosures.body: Almost universally treated as Mastery fodder and called the weakest sentinel in combat; its fishing precept is the only part anyone rates.
